questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes, figure 1 and figure 3 , the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 2 is common in both figure 1 and figure 3, it is clear that 3, 4, 5 and 6 are adjacent to it, and the remaining number i.e., 2 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ce56d377f3f83007ee7abf7228671df7959fe86b5c451fe22b38527f19e997a.png]

questions.question:
A + B means ‘A is the father of B’

A – B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the son of B’

A # B means ‘A is the daughter of B’

If A # B – C @ D + E, then how is A related to E?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
@

 
 #
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Son

 
 Daughter
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

Statement given : **A # B – C @ D + E**

So,

 
• A # B → A is the daughter of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa531b02b6dc592b0ac41a070c6a78e3521044ca5b3a17f1e08342c68daa2740.png] 

 
• B – C → B is the mother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/562501f534b72da6dac0e9fe49dae220ffa63cecddf6b6ebf9a9182ccc8db4a4.png] 

 
• C @ D → C is the son of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e18a040e21076055785d9be7400febe499df19bc577b3a6399eed8598c29bd6.png] 

 
• D + E → D is the father of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/870163b56fa4f86b640edbf5638609422b47dc19527fa877c958f7a33ba28414.png] ​

Thus, according to the final family tree, A is the sister of E.

Hence, "Sister" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All P are Q.

II. All R are Q.

**Conclusion:**

I. All Q are R.

II. All P are R.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fdbc29a7716d8a0a0925a2725d2a8b74ad9abc7b5b36d7d6fd4cb99472f69dfe.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All Q are R → Does not follow (As all R are Q. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. All P are R → Does not follow (As all P are Q and all R are Q. There is no definite relation between P and R So, it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion follows**".

questions.question: If L × M means that L is the mother of M, L – M means that L is the father of M, L ÷ M means that L is the sister of M, then which of the following expression shows that P is the father of R?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
L is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 

 
 
to M

 
 
 

So,

 
• Option - (1) → Q – P × R ⇒ Q is the father of P who is the mother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/866f3f56fb3a22645bc4250e9abec2a2e0bb8d957db2f79079be580f67dee6f7.png] 

Here, P is the mother of R.

 
• Option - (2) → P – Q ÷ R ⇒ P is the father of Q who is the sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b76094f6afc7248930a4973d53f46a1964a67bb7c5c316db99ca0b123b45b82.png] 

**Here, P is the father of R.**

 
• Option - (3) → P – Q × R ⇒ P is the father of Q who is the mother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dd025fd9774e43da3a5cd85db3a109fece2acd96b921b2537fdcc7b1cd50aa1.png] 

Here, P is the grand father of R.

 
• Option - (4) → R – P × Q ⇒ R is the father of P who is the mother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89aed11f1372a4b00b890003eebd1e5fc8b1394139be627fb2f39ec374da718c.png] ​

Here, P is the daughter of R.

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.
